item.title: How to check if a number is odd in JavaScript
item.description: Checking if a number is odd is essential for alternating patterns, conditional rendering, selective processing, and special-case logic in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used odd/even checks in grid layouts, list processing, and pattern-based styling throughout the component library. For the companion check, see how to check if a number is even in JavaScript.
